subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved as a diagnostic-only exec improvement, or should OpenClaw define a stronger exec private-network allow/block policy?
rationale: The code can add a clearer diagnostic narrowly, but changing whether exec may reach LAN hosts is a security boundary and product-policy choice shared with the existing SSRF/private-network issues.

options.title: Land diagnostic-only fix
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045 so current failures become explicit without broadening private-LAN access.

options.title: Define exec network policy first
options.body: Pause the diagnostic PR until maintainers decide whether exec should have an allow, deny, or confirm model for private-network targets.

options.title: Close as external network environment
options.body: Treat macOS/Tailscale/process filtering as outside OpenClaw and document only an external workaround, leaving exec behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Land diagnostic-only fix
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045 so current failures become explicit without broadening private-LAN access.

likelyOwner.reason: The central exec runtime implementation is attributed to this history, so this is the best available owner for the code-path decision.
